## Environment

macOS / architecture / app version:
Printer model / resolution / firmware family (no serial):
Connection / media / accessories:
Project version or SHA / workflow profile version:

## Expected versus actual

Include label counts/order and whether delivery is uncertain. Do not retry an uncertain job just to gather a screenshot.

## Reproduction

Prefer a synthetic fixture. Do not attach customer addresses, tracking/account data, full private PDFs, credentials or proprietary driver artifacts.

## Evidence and limitations

Commands/steps actually run, sanitized logs, and whether behavior was observed on physical hardware.
